candidate_rule: two non-promoted candidates per record: verified official fact or deterministic rounded-snapshot metric, plus explicit scope guard

scope_guards.july_snapshot: BDUK July 2026 values are rounded management-information data limited to initial contract scope, with variable ingestion lag; they do not establish exact-address completion, current availability, orderability or contractual milestone compliance.
scope_guards.derived_snapshot: Ranks, shares, gaps, bands and percentage-point comparisons are deterministic calculations over rounded displayed rows and displayed totals. Row sums can differ from displayed totals due to rounding, and these metrics are not official statistics or parcel-level delivery claims.
scope_guards.mobile_fault_scope: Ofcom mobile-fault guidance describes general troubleshooting, repair and complaint processes; actual fault cause, compensation and cancellation rights depend on the provider, contract and case facts.
scope_guards.mobile_switch_scope: Ofcom mobile-switching guidance describes standard PAC/STAC processes; timing, charges, number retention and compensation depend on provider and case facts.
scope_guards.checker_scope: Ofcom checker information is predictive and source-dependent; it does not prove current exact-address performance, temporary service status or orderability.
scope_guards.complaints_scope: Ofcom complaints data is aggregate regulator-received complaints per customer base; it does not represent all complaints, exact-address availability or individual case merit.

expansion_rule: For each July 2026 BDUK contract emit twelve records: supplier, contracted, built, built share, contracted-total share, built-total share, unbuilt gap, unbuilt share, contracted rank, built rank, completion rank and percentage-point difference from displayed overall completion. Append 76 Ofcom mobile-fault, mobile-switching, checker and complaints records. Equal numeric values share competition rank. Every fifth expanded record is REVALIDATION; all others are UPGRADE.
